request.description: Verifies a PAN with the KYC provider (`KYC_DRIVER`; `stub` outside production: PANs ending in Z are "not found"). The fourth character must fit the profile: P for individuals and proprietorships (stored on the person), F partnership, E LLP, C private limited (stored on the business). Stored encrypted with a blind index; verified only when the name on record matches the party. A PAN already on another party returns 409 `IDENTIFIER_IN_USE` (ops can merge). At most 5 checks per profile per day. A verified PAN completes the `verify_details` journey step. Borrower context for the applicant's own records; partner context for applications the firm filed (agents: the ones they filed). Others get 404.
